messages:
kendra_pm: Quick sync — we need a compact, unambiguous checklist for product entry into production next week. Focus areas: SLA targets, docs handoff, support runbook, monitoring & alerting, pricing notes, and any edge-case fallbacks. Can each area call out any open gaps?

alex_eng: SLA proposal is in the doc I linked earlier — target 99.95%% availability for hosted API, 99.9%% for Dedicated during peak. We should define error budget burn rate and a clear rollback trigger.

mira_prodops: Docs: current public docs cover endpoints + examples but missing failure modes and troubleshooting steps. I can draft a compact "what to check" runbook page for ops and support. Need screenshots of Console dashboards (cost & latency).

sam_sre: Monitoring: make sure we have token-level latency histograms, 95/99/99.9p SLI, and per-model error rates. Alerts: page (P2) at 5m sustained p99 > 600ms, and page (P1) when 15m error rate > 2%% across requests. Also need a synthetic canary job hitting a pinned model every 60s.

jo_support: Support readiness: oncall coverage looks okay but need playbook for degraded-model fallbacks and customer messaging templates (billing impact, degraded SLA). Who owns customer notifications? We should also add an internal escalation matrix for SEs -> Eng -> SRE.

alex_eng: Ownership: Engineering will own rollback and model-fallback playbook. Product owns customer comms templates. Ops to own canary. I'll add a small YAML snippet for automated fallback routing: 
```
fallback_policy:
  - condition: model_unhealthy
    action: route_to: "variant-quantized"
    notify: ["#eng-oncall", "#product"]
```

mira_prodops: Docs gap: need a short triage checklist for "slow responses" vs "incorrect outputs" — the latter needs eval rollback steps and prompt-set reference. I'll add a template eval TOC.

jo_support: Question: pricing readiness — do we have final per-token tiers for hosted vs dedicated? Billing needs mapping of metered units to usage dashboard. If pricing isn't finalized we should delay customer-facing docs.

kendra_pm: Pricing: finance signed off on draft tiers yesterday. I'll attach final table to the product drive. But agree — block customer docs until we upload final numbers. For launch internal docs, we can use "draft" labels.

sam_sre: Observability: also add tracing hooks for long-running requests and a way to correlate token-level cost for a trace. That helps debug expensive prompts. Can work with eng-runtime to emit trace IDs.

alex_eng: Runtime note: KV-cache warmup for long contexts can spike latency on first request. We should document expected cold-start penalty per model and suggest customer-side retries/backoff.

mira_prodops: Support runbook items I plan to deliver today: 1) triage checklist, 2) playbook links, 3) runbook TL;DR for SEs, 4) dashboard snapshots. Will post PR in the docs repo.

jo_support: I'll prep customer notification templates and an escalation matrix. Also will schedule a 30-min walkthrough for support team tomorrow 10:30 PT.

deploy-bot: deploy: build 2026.03.15-56 -> staged to prod-ready; smoke test: OK; canary job started.

kendra_pm: Outstanding gaps list (quick):
- Finalize SLA doc w/ error budget & rollback triggers (alex)
- Upload pricing table to drive & mark docs draft until confirmed (kendra)
- Add canary job + synthetic alerts (sam)
- Support playbook + customer templates (jo)
- Docs: triage checklist + eval rollback steps (mira)
- Runtime: cold-start guidance + fallback policy (alex)

kendra_pm: If we can close those by EOD tomorrow we can go ahead with the initial prod entry the following week. Ping in thread with status updates :thumbsup:

sam_sre: I'll own canary + alerts. ETA tomorrow noon.

alex_eng: I'll add SLA section and the fallback policy PR today.

mira_prodops: Draft runbook PR incoming in ~3h.

jo_support: Templates done by EOD and I'll set up the walkthrough invite.

kendra_pm: Perfect — thanks team. I'll collate and send a short preflight checklist to execs once items are closed.
